Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That's all we have from this game, but we will not have to wait too long for the next game to get underway in this enticing series. The action continues on Saturday 8th October. It will be Pakistan up against the hosts, New Zealand. The match is all set to begin at 11.30 am IST (6.00 am GMT). But join us in advance for the build-up. Till then, goodbye and take care!

Nurul Hasan the captain of Bangladesh says that it is a bit disappointing to lose the game. Adds that they need to improve a few areas, especially losing wickets in the middle which is a concern for them. Mentions that Taskin Ahmed bowled really well and credits the spinners as well but still they need to get better in the next game.

Babar Azam the skipper of Pakistan says that they are happy as a team and this win will give them a lot of confidence. Adds that they started well, Mohammad Rizwan did well again, he stayed till the end and took Pakistan to a good score. He praises Shan Masood for his batting as well. Further says that they were happy with the total. Mentions that the weather is different here but as professional cricketers, they need to be ready for everything. Adds that all the bowlers were excellent. Ends by saying that they are looking forward to the game against New Zealand.

Mohammad Rizwan is the Player of the Match. He says that it is a good feeling to win the man of the match for Pakistan. Adds that he and Babar Azam planned to keep things simple. Mentions that he found the pitch good to bat on but says that they were 10-15 runs short. He praises the bowlers for the way they defended the total. Tells that he believes in hard work. Ends by saying that some of the boundaries are big here and they tried to pick their moments.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the game, Bangladesh put Pakistan to bat first and they put up a fighting total of 167 on the board. It was once again Mohammad Rizwan who helped Pakistan get to that total. He scored unbeaten 78 runs off 50 balls for his side, while Babar Azam and Shan Masood chipped in with vital runs. In reply, Bangladesh suffered a batting collapse in the middle overs and let the game slip away from them.

It was a collective bowling performance from Pakistan. The spinners were exceptional in the middle overs, while the seamers took control in the slog overs. Mohammad Wasim and Mohammad Nawaz took 3 and 2 wickets respectively, whereas the other bowlers grabbed a wicket apiece.

Pakistan got off to a breezy start! They got rid of the openers within the Powerplay and had their noses ahead early in the innings. Litton Das and Afif Hossain then did some sort of repair work and took the momentum away from Pakistan. They put on a stand of 50 runs and put Bangladesh well in control. However, once that partnership was broken, they faced a batting collapse. From 87 for 2 they slipped to 119 for 8 and gave the game away. Yasir Ali did play some lusty blows towards the end. He scored 42 runs, but it was not enough to take his side over the line.

It's been a rather convincing victory for Babar Azam and his men! They have kicked off this Tri-Nation series with a win and have grabbed those crucial points. They will be pretty pleased with the show they have put on here. Whereas, Bangladesh have commenced this competition on the wrong foot and will have to make amends for their next game.

FOUR! A boundary to end but that will not be enough for Bangladesh. Haris Rauf bowls this full and on off, Yasir Ali goes for the slog but gets a top edge towards the vacant third man fence for a boudnary. PAKISTAN WIN BY 21 RUNS.

SIX! Yasir Ali continues to gather the runs here. This is a slower one again, full and on off, Yasir Ali waits for it and lofts it towards the long off fence where Shahnawaz Dahani tries to keep it inside but he is already standing on the ropes when he leaps to keep the ball in. The replays confirm the same and the umpire signals for a maximum.
FOUR! Good shot! Haris Rauf serves this on a good length and on off, Yasir Ali stays there and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Haris Rauf bowls a slower one, on a length and on off, Yasir Ali is through his heave way too early and misses.
On a length and on leg, Yasir Ali flicks it off the back foot towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Too little too late for Bangladesh! This is pitched up, on leg, Yasir Ali makes room and drills it down the ground towards the wide long on fence for a boudnary.
A full toss, on off, Mohammad Wasim tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! SMASHED! Mohammad Wasim serves this full and around off, Yasir Ali clears his front leg and crunches it wide of mid off for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Hasan Mahmud dabs it towards cover and takes a single.

A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire says no! Another ripper from Mohammad Wasim! A fuller ball, swing in, around the leg pole. Hasan Mahmud looks to flick this one but he misses and gets pinged on his pads. That was probably sliding down leg.
Wide! Oh, dear! Mohammad Wasim spills this one down the leg side, a full ball. Hasan Mahmud misses his flick. Wide given!
Hasan Mahmud comes to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TIMBER! Two in two Mohammad Wasim and this is another peach of a delivery. He nails another yorker, on middle, Nasum Ahmed moves his back leg and tries to block it but he is also too late to put his bat down and the ball goes through to shatter the stumps. Ahmed goes for a golden duck and Mohammad Wasim is on a hat-trick now.
Nasum Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! PLUMB IN FRONT! Mohammad Wasim gets another wicket and sends Taskin Ahmed back to the hut. He bowls a brilliant yorker, on middle, Taskin Ahmed looks to play at it but is too late to put his bat down and gets rapped around his pads right in front of the stumps. There is a huge appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Taskin Ahmed goes for the review. The UltraEdges shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows three reds. The original decision of Out remains and Bangladesh lose their seventh.
Mohammad Wasim comes to bowl the penultimate over of the game.
Goes a bit fuller and on off, Yasir Ali drills it back to the bowler where Shahnawaz Dahani stops it with his foot. 49 runs needed in 12 balls now.
On a length and around off, Yasir Ali moves across and tries for the scoop but misses. He is not happy with himself there.
SIX! BANG! Yasir Ali conncects this time! This is another slower one, short and on middle, Yasir Ali waits for it and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
A full toss and around off, Yasir Ali makes room but goes too far away from the ball and misses his slog.
Sharp bouncer! Shahnawaz Dahani bangs in a bouncer, on middle, zips through, Yasir Ali sways away from it.
FOUR! Good placement! This is short of a length and on middle, slower too, Yasir Ali manages to drag his pull shot wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Haris Rauf bowls a slower one again, full and on off, Taskin Ahmed is way too early through his shot and misses.
Another swing and a miss! Rauf bowls a slower one, full and on off, Taskin Ahmed tries to go for the big heave again but only connects with thin air.
Goes fuller this time, on leg, Taskin Ahmed heaves it towards mid-wicket where the fielder lets it through. Two runs taken!
Swing and a miss! Haris Rauf bowls this on good length and on leg, Taskin Ahmed goes for the slog but cannot connect.

On a length and outside off, Yasir Ali makes room and forces it towards extra cover for a run. Shadab Khan there gathers the ball but cannot gather himself to throw the ball or else there would have been a chance of a run out.
This is on a good length and on off, Yasir Ali lofts it towards the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a brace.
Slight halt! Yasir Ali has been struck on the back of his helmet with the throw by the fielder. The physio is out there. He seems fine though.

Mohammad Wasim serves a yorker, on leg, Taskin Ahmed misses his flick and the ball goes off the pads towards point, Yasir Ali sets off for the run but he is sent back midway through, Shan Masood picks up the ball and has shy at the bowler's end but he hits Ali on the helmet instead.
Short of a length and on off, Taskin Ahmed goes for the pull shot but misses as the ball deflects off his thigh pads towards the keeper.
Mohammad Wasim bowls this on a hard length and on leg, Yasir Ali gets hurried and mistime his shot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Wasim bangs in a bouncer, on off, Yasir Ali leaves it alone.
On a length and on middle, Yasir Ali pushes it back to the bowler.
This is on a hard length and on middle, Yasir Ali stays back and forces it wide of long on for a couple of runs.
Mohammad Wasim (2-0-14-0) is back on.
Quicker, fuller, around middle. Taskin Ahmed blocks it out. Another successful over from Pakistan!
Taskin Ahmed comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust. Bangladesh are falling like a pack of cards here. Shadab Khan serves a flighted one, slower through the air, full, around off, spinning away. Nurul Hasan gets down on his knee and slog-sweeps this one across the line. But he miscues his shot completely and finds the fielder at long on. Iftikhar Ahmed pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Iftikhar Ahmed b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, tossed up, outside off, a leg break. Nurul Hasan looks to sweep this one but he fails to get any bat on that one.
Outside off, fuller in length. Nurul Hasan opens the face of the bat and taps it towards point. No run there!
Outside off, fuller ball. Yasir Ali leans in and drives it towards cover for another run.
Flighted ball, full, around off, Nurul Hasan works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Yasir Ali walks out to bat now. Also, Shadab Khan (3-0-28-0) to finish his spell now.

OUT! TAKEN! A good move to bring back Shahnawaz Dahani! He gets rid of a set batter here and Bangladesh are in deep trouble now. A length ball, around off. Afif Hossain walks across and looks to flick this one over mid-wicket with an angled bat. He gets only elevation on that one. Mohammad Wasim runs back and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Wasim b Shahnawaz Dahani

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan guides it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide of off. Nurul Hasan stays in his crease and slaps it over cover for a cracking boundary.
Outside off, short ball. Nurul Hasan looks to ramp it over short third man but he misses.
Another short ball, around middle. Afif Hossain shuffles across and pulls it towards square leg once again. Another single.
Back of a length, around middle. Nurul Hasan pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Shahnawaz Dahani is back on. He has conceded just 7 runs in his two overs.
FOUR! Up and over! That is a beautiful shot! Mohammad Nawaz tosses it up, full and on off, Afif Hossain chips it over extra cover for a boundary.
A fuller ball, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan drives it towards long off for a single. No hat-trick for Mohammad Nawaz!

OUT! LBW! Two wickets in two balls for Mohammad Nawaz and all of a sudden Bangladesh find themselves in a spot of bother! A shorter ball, this one comes in with the arm, around middle and leg. Mosaddek Hossain rocks back and looks to flick this one but he misses and gets hit on the pads. A huge shout for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Mosaddek Hossain opts for a review. UltraEdge shows a flat line as the ball passes through the bat. The Ball Tracking indicates three reds and Bangladesh lose their fourth wicket.
Nurul Hasan, the skipper is the next man in for Bangladesh.
Mosaddek Hossain comes out to the middle now.

OUT! Mohammad Nawaz strikes in his final over and breaks this stand! This partnership was looking threatening. But Mohammad Nawaz has sent back the dangerous, Litton Das. A huge wicket for them. Tossed up, full, around middle and off. Litton Das gets down on his knee and goes the slog-sweep. He fails to get the desired elevation as he finds the fielder at deep square leg. Haider Ali leaps and takes a good catch over his head.
Commentary.Howout: c Haider Ali b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Short again, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain skips down the pitch and miscues his heave towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off, short in length. Afif Hossain chops it towards backward point for a brace.

A loopy ball, slower through the air, around the leg pole. Afif Hossain gets down on his knee and to sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads. The balls rolls away towards short fine leg. Litton Das wanted a single there, but he is sent back. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end but he misses. The batters cross ends for a leg bye. A huge shout for LBW there, but not given. Babar Azam goes up the review. No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates it was pitching outside leg. Not Out it is!
Review time! Pakistan have taken a review for LBW against Afif Hossain.
A fuller ball, tossed up as well, outside off. Litton Das drives it towards cover. A fumble by Babar Azam there allows the batters to take a single.
Oh, a beauty by Shadab Khan! Slower through the air, this one lands around off, and spins away. Litton Das misses his flick.
Play and a miss! Outside off, spinning away, fuller ball. Litton Das gets down on his knee and misses sweep.
SIX! High and Handsome! This is good aggression by Litton Das! A leg-break, full, around off. Litton Das shimmies down the pitch and tonks it straight down the ground for a maximum.
A fuller ball, sliding into the pads. Litton Das flicks it towards square leg for a brace.
Pitched up, outside off. Litton Das strokes it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Litton Das! An action reply! Full again, outside off. Litton Das shuffles across, gets on his knee and sweeps it over short fine leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! A fuller one now, loopy ball, around middle. Litton Das gets down on his knee and sweeps it over the fielder at square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Afif Hossain knocks it out towards long on. A single now.
Outside off again, tad shorter. Afif Hossain rocks back and looks to guide this one towards third man. But the ball goes off the under edge onto the boot of Mohammad Rizwan.
Spinning in, a short ball, around middle. Afif Hossain stays in his crease and blocks it out.

Drinks break! The game is pretty evenly poised at the halfway mark of the innings. Litton Das and Afif Hossain have done well after losing two wickets in quick succession. These two will need to stick around for a little while longer and step on the gas sooner rather than later. Pakistan on the other hand will look to grab a few quick wickets and put Bangladesh under pressure.
Another single as this short delivery is worked towards mid-wicket. Six singles in the over then.
Quicker one, full and on off, Litton Das opnes the face of his bat and guides it towards covers for a run.
A googly now, short and on middle, Afif Hossain moves back and pushes it towards long on for one more.
A bit short and around leg, Litton Das moves across and sweeps it past short fine leg for one.
A full toss and on middle, Afif Hossain smashes it towards long on for another run.
Looped up, full and on middle, Litton Das gets to the pitch of it and tucks it towards mid-wciekt for a single.
Flighted, full and on off, Litton Das moves across and sweeps it hard but finds the fielder at deep backward square leg for just a run.
Short again and on off, Litton Das stays back and cuts it straight to point.
Floated, full and on middle, Afif Hossain goes for the reverse sweeps but straight to short third man. They cross.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Litton Das works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Short again and on middle, Afif Hossain goes on his back foot and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on middle, Afif Hossain moves back and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Good shot! This is short and outside off, Litton Das stays there and cuts it through point for a boundary.

Quicker one now, on off, Afif Hossain guides it towards backward point and sets off for the run, the fielder there fumbles and the batters complete the run. If he would have picked it up cleanly there was a chance of a run out.
Floated, full and on middle, Litton Das sweeps it nicely towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Afif Hossain eases it towards long off for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Afif Hossain puts this one into the stands! Shadab Khan bowls a half-tracker, on leg, Afif Hossain clears his front leg and heaves it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Shadab Khan starts with a googly, full and on off, turning away, Afif Hossain looks to sweep it but misses.
Shadab Khan comes on to bowl.
Quicker one, full and on middle, Afif Hossain makes room and pushes it towards point for one.
Looped up and around middle, Litton Das sweeps it uppishly towards deep square leg for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Litton Das blocks it back to the bowler.
Floated, full and around leg, Litton Das sweeps it but straight to short fine leg.
A bit short and on off, Afif Hossain forces it towards long on for a single.

Mohammad Nawaz starts with a flatter delivery, short and on off, Afif Hossain looks to cut it but misses and it carries through to Mohammad Rizwan. There is an appeal for caught behind but turned down. Mohammad Nawaz convinces Babar Azam to take the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved and the onfield decision of Not Out remains.
Time for some spin as Mohammad Nawaz is brought into the attack.
A low full toss, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it wide of mid off and gets iff the mark with a single. Bangladesh are 38 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay.
Afif Hossain walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Haris Rauf finally gets his man and this time he does it all by himself. He bowls this fuller in length and on middle, Sabbir Rahman looks to flick it away but closes the face of his bat a bit too early. As a result, it takes the leading edge and goes straight up in the air. Haris Rauf calls for it and takes a nice catch. He smashes the ball onto the ground in aggression. Bangladesh have lost both their openers now.
Haris Rauf lands this short and on middle, Litton Das mistimes his pull shot towards deep square leg for a run.
Goes fuller again and on middle, Sabbir Rahman flicks it through square leg for another run.
This is on a length and around off, Litton Das looks to play at it but gets a leading edge past point for a run.
Haris Rauf goes for the yorker but bowls a low full toss, on middle, Sabbir Rahman tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, a length delivery. Litton Das blocks it out off the back foot.

FOUR! Half a chance there! A short ball, down the leg side. Litton Das swivels and pulls it towards short fine leg. The ball goes through the hands of the fielder there for a boundary. Had he timed his jump perfectly, he could have taken the catch there.
Angling in, around middle and leg. Litton Das nudges it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
FOUR LEG BYES! Down the leg side, on a length. Litton Das looks to flick this one fine but he misses. The ball brushes his thigh pad and goes past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
Litton Das walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Change of ends has worked for Mohammad Wasim! He draws first blood as he sends back Mehidy Hasan. A short ball, around middle. Mehidy Hasan goes for the pull shot but the ball goes off the top half of the bat towards deep square leg. Asif Ali keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a good clean catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Asif Ali b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, around middle. Sabbir Rahman works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Change of ends for Mohammad Wasim. He conceded 9 runs in his first over.
Wide of off, very short this time. Mehidy Hasan dances down the pitch and looks to go over cover but he fails to make any connection.
A good-length delivery, outside off, Mehidy Hasan shuffles across and tries to scoop this one but he fails to get any bat on that one.
Fraction short this time, around middle. Mehidy Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
SIX! BOOM! Mehidy Hasan finally gets one off the middle. A fuller ball, in the slot, around off. Mehidy Hasan gets his from leg away and thumps it over mid on all the way for a biggie.

In the air...and safe! A length ball, outside off. Sabbir Rahman shuffles across and tries to paddle it over short fine leg. But the ball goes off the outside off and lands short of Shahnawaz Dahani at third man. Another single.
Haris Rauf begins with a low full toss, around off, at 138.3 clicks. Mehidy Hasan looks to drive this one but the ball goes off the inner half wide of mid on. A single.
Haris Rauf comes into the attack now.

Two now! Good shot from Sabbir Rahman! Slightly short, around off. Sabbir Rahman leans back and upper cuts it over short third man. Mohammad Wasim chases the ball and keeps it away from the boundary ropes. Two taken.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Sabbir Rahman steers it towards backward point. Back-to-back dot balls.
On a nagging length, around off. Sabbir Rahman dabs it towards point. A dot now.
Outside off, fraction short. Sabbir Rahman slices it over the fielder at cover. Manages to juts clear the infield. Only a couple of runs taken.
Darting this one the thigh pad, a length ball. Mehidy Hasan tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Swing and a miss! Angling away this time, outside off, a length ball. Mehidy Hasan dances down the pitch and misses his slog.
Another play and a miss! A length ball, around middle. Sabbir Rahman skips down the pitch and misses his pull shot. He gets beaten on the inside edge here.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Slightly short now, around middle. Sabbir Rahman gets on top of this one and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. First boundary of the chase!
Another dot! A good-length delivery, around the leg pole. Sabbir Rahman looks to pull this one but he misses. The ball ballons up off his thigh pad.
Swing and a miss! On a length, around middle and leg, at around 134 clicks. Sabbir Rahman dances down the pitch, and swings his bat across the line to go over mid on, but he misses.
Wide! Third wide of the over. Down the leg side, a length delivery. Sabbir Rahman misses his flick. Wided.
Another good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Mehidy Hasan rocks back and dabs it in front of mid on. Another run is taken.
A length ball now, around middle. Sabbir Rahman taps it towards mid on for a single.
Wide! Mohammad Wasim errs in line again! He sprays it down leg. Sabbir Rahman misses his pull and a wide is called.
Wide! Mohammad Wasim begins with a length ball, he spills it down the leg side. Sabbir Rahman lets that one go through. Wide given.
Mohammad Wasim to bowl from the other end.
Angling in, a length ball, around middle and leg. Sabbir Rahman tucks it towards square leg and takes a single. He retains the strike. A good first over from Shahnawaz Dahani. Just two runs off it.
Full in length, outside off. Sabbir Rahman drives it firmly but once again finds the fielder at extra cover.
A good-length delivery, outside off, tailing back in, at 138.7 clicks. Sabbir Rahman leaves that alone.
Pitches it up again, the line is outside off. Sabbir Rahman leans in and drives it towards the fielder at cover.
Touch fuller this time, outside off again. Mehidy Hasan pushes it towards mid off and scampers across to the other end. Mehidy Hasan and Bangladesh are up and running.
Shahnawaz Dahani begins with a length ball, angling in, around off. Mehidy Hasan blocks it out.
